_about: Census-people basis store for the 2004 federal election (the 2001-census c0 side of the 2004 people-interpolation lane; the two sides blend to election day at the SEIFA pcti lane's day-share, see the demoInterp record). The people-smallest-area is a 2001-census collection district (ASGC 2001 CD): a booth's demo block is the 2001 Basic Community Profile counts of the CD its venue sits in — the venue's neighbourhood, never the booth's voters, mapped by data/booth-seifa-2004.json's own `geo` field (most 2004 premises coords are carried from the 2007 poll-book addresses; counts.boothsGeoMissing/boothsGeoEmpty are the rows the carry never reached or that stand outside a populated CD). A division's row is the exact 2001-BCP sum over the CDs whole-allocated to its division (seifa-src/cd-2001-ced-2003ed.json), real headcounts, never vote-weighted pseudo-populations. The 2001 BCP ships as ~35,000 per-CD spreadsheets (no bulk 2001 datapack on abs.gov.au; source is the archive.org mirror of the ABS CDATA-era product), tallied per CD into an extraction table by extract-bcp-2001-tally.py, and overseas visitors ride their own row inside several 2001 tables' totals and are subtracted so every lane is the as-enumerated resident count the GCP-era products take. Two balance-area CDs carry a truncated workbook (no demographic tables) and count people but share no lanes (counts.cdsShortTable/personsShortTable — the not-stated doctrine over whole tables). Anglophone-age-language-foreign-born-uni shares mirror d13's; OCCUPATION is the ASCO classification (pre-ANZSCO): blue-collar maps {Tradespersons, Intermediate Production & Transport, Labourers} onto the ANZSCO 3/7/8 lane (broadly comparable per ABS, the named definitional wobble). The new lane set rides the BCP's own 2001 tables: B 10's Religion menu ten shares (rel, key order in relKeys, No-religion leading; the orth lane sums the edition's two "Orthodox"/"Oriental Christian" rows) over the ex-affiliation-not-stated persons-ex-overseas basis (B 10's grand and B 01's persons row disagree by ~0.2% per CD inside the 2001 product itself, so the religion basis is B 10's own grand less its not-stated and overseas rows); B 12's year-12-or-less over the stated schooling levels (its "Still at school" row kept out of the basis to hold the GCP-era stated-level frame); B 01's total Indigenous persons over persons ex-overseas — the 2001 product publishes no Indigenous-status-not-stated row, so the lane's basis is persons ex-overseas and the share runs a few per cent relative under the later editions' ex-not-stated basis; B 19's Housing-tenure menu four shares (ten, key order in tenKeys, owned-with-mortgage leading; the 2001 print has no grand-total column; its rented total rides the printed rented-total column) over the ex-tenure-not-stated occupied-private-dwellings basis; B 17's one-parent share of families; and the under-15 share of the stated ages. Birthplace countries ride cobKeys/cob on the measured side (the /map/ Born-overseas country menu: whole-UK leading as eng leads the 2021-era menu, then the era's eight); the interp blend's demoI never carries a cob key — cob is read measured, never blended. Income lanes ride the BCP's own B 30/B 31 tables through the shared income engine (income_lanes.py — the GCP-era recipe verbatim on this edition's own grids): B 31's 12-band weekly household-income histogram re-weighted to ADULTS at the data/income-dist.json factors (each band's family share from B 30's Tot over the band's family-type mix — national mix as fallback — Negative/Nil households folding into the $1-$199 band, partial-stated and all-not-stated kept out of every basis); loinc the adult share below the national 25th-percentile weekly household-income cut of the incomeCuts record (2001 dollars), hiinc the adult share in the $2,000-or-more top band — this edition's hi edge, lower capped than later censuses' $3,000+/$4,000+ tops (the page's own wording reads the store's incomeCuts.hiEdgeWeekly), incMed the band-interpolated median weekly household income in 2001 dollars on the HOUSEHOLD basis (ABS's own published-median basis). The demoI blocks interpolate the people figures between the 2001 and 2006 censuses to election day (day-share 0.634373 of the intercensal span — the SEIFA pcti lanes' own factors, asserted identical to data/booth-seifa-2004.json's _pcti record): each demoI lane blends the two census sides' shares, a lane missing on either side falling back to the measured block for that lane; incMed and the incomeCutsI dollar figures come from the 2006 census side alone, never a mixed-currency blend. The far side of the blend is data/booth-demo-2004-c1.json.

sourceUrls.bcp: ABS 2001 Census Basic Community Profile, per-CD xlsx (archive.org mirror of the CDATA-era CD product, identifier 2001-bcp-cd-00_aus)

deliveryBasis: venue-CD lookup per booth (the venue seifa store's own 2001-CD geo of the premises); exact CD sum per division (cd-2001-ced-2003ed)

booths.booth: Geraldton St John of God Hospital

demoInterp.nullRule: a booth missing its demo block on either census side, or a lane missing on either side, shows the measured figure instead

incomeCutsI.medianBasis: households (shares are per-adult); hiinc pinned to the nearest census side (hi edges differ across the blend's editions)
